scope: Twenty-one auxiliary search and checking statements with a person and environment as explicit inputs.
open_items: Derive a candidate generator from the unchanged Hug retrieval and guard rules.
Define intended correctness and prove the current checker faithful to it.
Encode the relevant full person/environment information finitely without changing the decision.
Provide an executable checker with polynomial runtime and a polynomial witness bound.
Account for all preparation and computation costs and give a uniform complexity proof.
Prove validity during an evolving encounter, including any needed rechecking protocol.
